_comment_data_level: Input product: 'L1' (rcs_0 daily), 'L2_daily' or 'L2_monthly' (attenuated_backscatter_0 reconstructed). folder_root must match.
_comment_abs_cs: Empty = use the bundled 910 nm WV LUT (calibration/data/abs_cross_wv_910nm.nc). Set a path to override with a full-band external LUT.
_comment_night: Night selection for the (night-only) Rayleigh fit. use_sza_night=1 -> darkness-adaptive window: keep profiles with solar zenith angle > sza_night_threshold deg (100 = sun ~10 deg below horizon; 108 = astronomical, strictest). use_sza_night=0 -> fixed solar-clock window hour_min..hour_max. SZA falls back to the clock window if station coordinates are missing.
_comment_polar: Polar-summer low-sun fallback (v2.3, calibration/rayleigh/polar.py, doc/v2.3/polar_summer.md). 0 = off = operational behaviour. With 1, a night whose window has no more than polar_trigger_dark_hours with SZA > sza_night_threshold (none north of ~56.6 N around the solstice) is calibrated on its lowest-sun profiles: SZA > max(min(SZA_max - polar_sza_delta, SZA at +-polar_min_hours/2 around solar midnight), polar_min_sza), i.e. by default the 6 h centred on solar midnight with the sun never higher than 12 deg (background <= 3 x dark). Flag 0.25 = low-sun success (counted as a success); -14 = rejected (window above polar_min_sza shorter than min_time_range, or, only if polar_max_residual_pct > 0, far-range (polar_residual_band_m, m) residual background implying a larger C_L bias in %). polar_max_residual_pct = 0 keeps that residual as a diagnostic in the message.
_comment_time_aggregation: Time collapse before the molecular fit: 'mean' (efficient for the weak-signal photon noise at 3-6 km) with 'screen_profile_outliers' to drop residual-aerosol/cloud/noise profiles first. A plain 'median' profile is robust to outliers but ~1.5x noisier at weak-signal altitudes (worse night-to-night), so screen+mean is preferred.
_comment_cloud: Full profiles are excluded if the cloud base is below this altitude
_comment_range: Molecular window search: center position between these values
_comment_window_gates: Molecular-window validity gates (reject aerosol/low-SNR; see rayleigh_fit.find_optimal_molecular_window). min_window_start_m: the window must START above this altitude (m AGL), i.e. above the boundary-layer aerosol (rec #1). min_window_r2: minimum R^2 of the signal-vs-molecular linear fit (cf. MATLAB min_r2_rfit=0.5). max_window_rel_error: max % deviation of the fit slope from the pointwise median ratio (rejects aerosol curvature, rec #2). Best window = highest R^2 among eligible windows; if none qualifies the night is flagged non-calibration instead of emitting a spurious low-R^2 constant.
_comment_molecular_method: Molecular-window detection strategy, keyed by E-PROF version (molecular_methods.py): 'eprof_v2' (Major changes, Rayleig+cloud, better molecular detection), 'eprof_v1.2' (sign corrected, minor modifications) | 'eprof_v1.1' (legacy main, sign-corrected) | 'eprof_v0.25' (MATLAB Auto_Calib_25: forced b=0, min ΣRMSE, R² floor) | 'earlinet' (lowest qualifying, shape+SNR) |  | 'bellini' (ALICENET, 3-7 km, Breusch-Godfrey). Legacy aliases improved/main/matlab/optimal still accepted. E-PROF v1.0 (sign error) = eprof_v1.1 window + sign_error_v10. The min_window_*/max_window_* gates apply to 'eprof_v1.2'; other methods use their own defaults.
_comment_uncertainty_model: Uncertainty of the nightly Rayleigh constant (calibration/rayleigh/uncertainty.py, doc/v2.3/uncertainty.md). 'ensemble' (default, v2.2, bit-identical output): lidar_constant_uncertainty = 2 x robust sigma of the 125-member LR x window-shift x time ensemble. 'v2.3': same C_L, the uncertainty becomes 2 sigma of the quadrature sum ensemble + vertical consistency (C_L in sub-windows over the usable molecular range, |dlnC/dz| x a representative window displacement) + molecular model (US-1976 vs real T/p) + photon noise; the components are written to the calibration NetCDF and the 'u > C' QC (-6) becomes a relative limit. uncertainty_params overrides calibration.rayleigh.uncertainty.DEFAULT_PARAMS (empty = validated defaults).
_comment_kalman_uncertainty_weighting: Network runner only: 1 = weight each night of the Kalman best estimate by its reported relative uncertainty (ratio to the series median, clipped x4); 0 (default) = operational, equally weighted. Env ALC_KALMAN_UNCERTAINTY_WEIGHTING overrides.
_comment_molecular: Molecular reference source (beta_mol ~ P/T): 'standard' (US Std 1976, matches MATLAB) or 'cams' (actual CAMS T/p, same archive as the WV correction). <1% difference at mid-latitudes.
_comment_wv: Water-vapor correction for 910 nm instruments (CL31/CL51/CL61). A 910 nm night without matching CAMS is stopped. 1064 nm (CHM15k) is unaffected.
_comment_cams_download: Auto-download a missing CAMS file from the ADS instead of skipping the night (needs cdsapi + cfgrib + ADS credentials in ~/.cdsapirc; the Atmosphere Data Store endpoint is selected automatically). 0=off (default; calibration stays offline). cams_download_scope: 'day' = fetch just the night CAMS_Beta_<YYYYMMDD>.nc (light; the only choice valid for a recent date whose month is not yet complete); 'month' = the whole completed CAMS_Beta_<YYYYMM>.nc (heavy but reused by every night that month). Either file is accepted on read.
